subject: general
question: Ustad Allarakha Qureshi, also known as Alla Rakha, was associated with which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tabla__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Allarakha Qureshi was an Indian tabla player hailing from Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• He was a frequent accompanist of Sitar Player, Pt. Ravi Shankar.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shree Award in 1977.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
